name: Japanese woodblocks
description: Woodblock prints, most of them from the Edo period, of Mount Fuji, rivers, bridges, harbours, birds and flowers by Hokusai, Hiroshige and their contemporaries, for a calm and colourful landscape screen.

works.alt_text: Mount Fuji glows reddish-brown under a blue sky streaked with rows of small white clouds, its slopes fading to dark green forest.
Large orange, pink and yellow chrysanthemums with green leaves fill the sheet, with a small horsefly hovering above them.
A steep, patterned mountain pass rises beside a calm blue lake at Hakone, with a line of tiny travellers crossing the slope.
Passengers with umbrellas ride a ferry boat across a blue river past snow-covered banks, trees and rooftops.
Cargo ships with white sails sail into a harbour under rays of sunrise, with green pine-covered hills and cranes flying overhead.
Two women in blue and green kimonos look out across a pale bay at sunrise, with Mount Fuji tiny on the horizon.
A long wooden bridge crosses a wide blue river toward a castle town and a dark blue mountain.
Two grey wild geese rest among tall reeds on a pale sheet, drawn in soft ink tones.
A snow-capped Mount Fuji rises in a pink spring sky over a wide bay with small boats, pine trees and a village in front.
A curving beach leads toward red-rocked Enoshima island and white Mount Fuji, with travellers and a packhorse on the sand.
Workers tend tall, smoking tile kilns on a riverbank, with a blue mountain in the distance and a slender tree on the right.
A pair of mallard ducks stand on a muddy bank in front of large grey lotus leaves and seed pods.
A dark blue stream winds through golden grasses below a misty grey hill topped with two trees, with poems in the sky.
Travellers cross a pink plank bridge over a bright blue mountain river, with autumn maples and cherry trees on the banks.
A path winds through hills of autumn trees toward a blue lake, with small figures walking and resting along the way.
Travellers in blue walk past a row of shops along a seaside road, with sailing boats moored in the bay beyond.
Cargo ships with large white sails float on a calm blue bay between the waterfront houses of an island, under a clear sky.
A high stone arch bridge spans a calm river with a covered pleasure boat passing beneath and pine trees on either bank.
A wooden bridge arches high over a deep green gorge where a white waterfall tumbles below.
A shrine roof stands among pine trees on a hill overlooking a wide, pale bay with distant islands.
Three travellers with umbrellas and straw raincoats pause beside a snowy tree as snow falls.
Crowds stroll under red lanterns beside a great wooden bridge at evening, with decorated boats on the river and Mount Fuji far away.
Shrine halls and courtyards sit among pine trees on a hillside above a misty bay with white sails on the water.
Western sailing ships and small boats cross a blue harbour in front of a row of grand waterfront buildings, watched by people on the quay.
